scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I'm checking on the status of my housing loan application. Could you tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, what is the interest rate for my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and the loan has been originated. The interest rate for your loan is 6.624%.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for letting me know. Could you also tell me if there are any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on my loan? Additionally, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA. It also does not have any negative amortization features. Your loan has been sold to Freddie Mac.

dialogue.user: I see. What is my debt-to-income ratio, and what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is 43%. You were approved for a Conventional:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user:
Okay, thank you for the information. That's all I needed to know.

<Very Satisfied> The agent was polite, knowledgeable, and provided all the information I needed in a clear and concise manner. I feel confident about my loan details now.
